name: Memecoin native-price range breakout
hypothesis: Buy a Solana memecoin (BONK, WIF) when its SOL-denominated price closes above its prior 48-bar high and the USD price is above its 20-bar EMA; 3-ATR stop, 2R target.

entry.long: close / sym("SOL-USD", close) > highest(close / sym("SOL-USD", close), 48)[1] and close > ema(close,20)
